subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a monk who maintained a grapple on the Pudding King, dragged him through Glabbagool, took acid damage from the gelatinous cube, and used magical protections to resist the worst effects. He later considered Glabbagool's potential to become a monk and took a mental note to suggest training in mental discipline.
source_quote: Zalthir pulled the Pudding King directly through Glabbagool, who remarked that it tickled.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz launched magical missiles at the Pudding King, later channeled powerful energy into unerring strikes, and called down a massive fire explosion that engulfed Prince Livid and Princess Ebonmire.
source_quote: Daz channeled powerful magical energy into missiles that unerringly struck the Pudding King.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin navigated around green slime hazards, struck the Pudding King with darts that accidentally hit Glabbagool, and later used his radiant sword Dawnbringer to sear through the corrupted ooze.
source_quote: Thorin struck with his radiant sword Dawnbringer, its holy light searing through the corrupted ooze.

subject: Prince Livid
fact: Prince Livid is an ally of the Pudding King who retaliated with psychic blasts, survived a fire explosion due to flame resistance, but was ultimately destroyed by a volley of magical missiles.
source_quote: Prince Livid's resistance to flames allowed him to survive with grievous injuries.

subject: Princess Ebonmire
fact: Princess Ebonmire hurled blobs of acidic ooze at the party, fought on after the Pudding King’s defeat, and was destroyed by a combination of necrotic magic and physical strikes.
source_quote: Princess Ebonmire fell to a combination of necrotic magic and physical strikes.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a gelatinous cube companion who was accidentally struck by Thorin’s darts, swapped bodies with the Pudding King, remarked that being passed through tickled, and may now possess the consciousness of the former Pudding King.
source_quote: Glabbagool remarked that it tickled.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King was a sentient, telepathic ooze manifestation of Juiblex, capable of transforming into a slime wave, controlling green slime in his lair, and projecting his voice telepathically. After being dragged from his throne room, his power waned, and he was dissolved by Zalthir’s eldritch strikes, his consciousness dissipating into inert puddles.
source_quote: With a final telepathic scream—'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!'—the Pudding King dissolved completely.

subject: Green Slime
fact: Green slime hung from the throne room ceiling, ready to drop on anyone passing beneath it, and was used by the Pudding King as a lair hazard. It continued to fall on those knocked prone after the slime wave, though most rolled clear.
source_quote: Green slime hanging from the ceiling ready to drop on anyone who passed beneath it.

subject: Throne Room
fact: The throne room was the Pudding King’s domain, granting him additional power through lair actions, containing green slime hazards, and serving as the site of the initial battle. His power diminished after being dragged from it.
source_quote: The throne room itself proved treacherous, with green slime hanging from the ceiling...

subject: Underdark
fact: The Underdark is the broader setting where the battle occurred, now threatened by the rising influence of Zuggtmoy as fungi grow more twisted and malevolent following the Pudding King’s defeat.
source_quote: The fungi growing throughout the cavern were becoming more twisted and malevolent in appearance...

subject: Juiblex
fact: Juiblex, the demon lord of oozes, is the source of the Pudding King’s power. His demonic presence receded after the Pudding King’s dissolution, but a demonic voice echoed, declaring his intent to be reborn and consume Zuggtmoy’s banquet to grow stronger.
source_quote: A demonic voice echoed through the chamber, possibly Juiblex himself, declaring that he would be reborn and consume the banquet of the queen of fungi to grow even stronger.

subject: Zuggtmoy
fact: Zuggtmoy, the demon queen of fungi, is moving to fill the power vacuum left by the Pudding King’s defeat, as fungi throughout the cavern grow more twisted and malevolent in appearance.
source_quote: The fungi growing throughout the cavern were becoming more twisted and malevolent in appearance, suggesting that Zuggtmoy... was already moving to fill the power vacuum.

subject: Bag of Holding
fact: The party considered using the Bag of Holding to contain the Pudding King, but realized a sentient ooze could simply ooze back out through the opening.
source_quote: The party discussed using their Bag of Holding to contain the ooze, but realized that while they could temporarily shove him inside to deprive him of action, a sentient ooze could simply ooze back out through the opening.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is Thorin’s radiant sword whose holy light seared through the corrupted ooze of the Pudding King.
source_quote: Thorin struck with his radiant sword Dawnbringer, its holy light searing through the corrupted ooze.

subject: Body Swap
fact: An impossible body swap occurred between the Pudding King and Glabbagool, confirmed when Thorin asked where they first met and the ooze responded they met in a cave, revealing Glabbagool now held the Pudding King’s consciousness.
source_quote: Thorin tested this by asking where they first met, and the ooze near him responded that they had met in a cave—confirming it was indeed their friendly gelatinous cube ally.

subject: Pudding King’s Dissolution
fact: The Pudding King was dissolved by Zalthir’s eldritch-enhanced flurry of strikes after being removed from his lair, his consciousness dissipating as his form melted into inert puddles.
source_quote: With a final telepathic scream—'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!'—the Pudding King dissolved completely, his consciousness dissipating as his physical form melted into inert puddles.

subject: Demons’ Power Shift
fact: Juiblex’s demonic presence receded from the Underdark after the Pudding King’s defeat, while Zuggtmoy’s influence grew through twisted fungi, setting up a new conflict between the two demon lords.
source_quote: The toxic, oppressive presence of Juiblex's demonic power began to recede... however, they noticed that the fungi... were becoming more twisted and malevolent...

subject: Glabbagool’s Monk Training
fact: Zalthir took a mental note to suggest Glabbagool begin training in mental discipline to control his body and the effects of his acidity, implying a potential future arc where the gelatinous cube becomes a monk.
source_quote: He took a mental note to suggest that Glabbagool begin the training to become a monk.

subject: Juiblex’s Rebirth
fact: A demonic voice declared Juiblex would be reborn and consume Zuggtmoy’s banquet to grow stronger, foreshadowing a future conflict between the demon lords of oozes and fungi.
source_quote: A demonic voice echoed through the chamber, possibly Juiblex himself, declaring that he would be reborn and consume the banquet of the queen of fungi to grow even stronger.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a sentient ooze who recently swapped bodies with the Pudding King, now inhabiting the Pudding King's form and speaking with a voice that does not match his original identity.
source_quote: Why are you hurting me?

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King is a sentient ooze who swapped bodies with Glabbagool, now inhabiting Glabbagool's gelatinous cube form and expressing ecstatic, telepathic intentions about transformation and consumption.
source_quote: I have shed my humanoid form for the supreme power! I shall reduce all of deep known kind into nothing but ooze!

subject: body swap
fact: Glabbagool and the Pudding King have swapped bodies, causing confusion among the party when familiar voices emerge from incorrect ooze forms.
source_quote: The party realizes Glabbagool and the Pudding King have swapped bodies when a familiar voice comes from the wrong ooze

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a gelatinous cube that was previously a sentient ooze, now temporarily inhabiting the Pudding King’s form after a body swap, and capable of expressing tactile reactions such as 'this tickles'.
source_quote: this tickles

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King is a sentient ooze that has taken over Glabbagool’s gelatinous cube form after a body swap, and now expresses grandiose, ecstatic pronouncements about transformation and consumption.
source_quote: Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!

subject: battle maneuver
fact: Zalthir grapples the Pudding King in ooze form and drags him into Glabbagool, triggering a moment of tactile feedback that reveals the nature of their forms.
source_quote: Zalthir grapples the Pudding King in ooze form and drags him into Glabbagool, prompting the gelatinous cube to say 'this tickles'

subject: spellbook
fact: A spellbook containing numerous magical formulas was discovered in the aftermath of the battle, having been consumed by Princess Ebonmire and now serving as a key resource for the party’s arcane capabilities.
source_quote: searching the aftermath of the battle, the party discovered treasure that had been consumed by Princess Ebonmire—a spellbook containing numerous magical formulas

subject: escape from Underdark
fact: The party has secured their primary objective: a way out of the Underdark, achieving a significant victory despite lingering threats from the Abyss and the forces of Zuggtmoy and Juiblex.
source_quote: more importantly, they had achieved their primary objective: securing a way out of the Underdark

subject: body swap consequences
fact: The body swap between Glabbagool and the Pudding King remains unresolved, with the party now needing to determine how to restore their original forms or adapt to their new identities.
source_quote: The party realizes Glabbagool and the Pudding King have swapped bodies when a familiar voice comes from the wrong ooze

subject: Princess Ebonmire
fact: Princess Ebonmire consumed a spellbook containing numerous magical formulas, which the party later recovered from her remains after the battle.
source_quote: searching the aftermath of the battle, the party discovered treasure that had been consumed by Princess Ebonmire

subject: Abyssal demonic forces
fact: The demonic forces of the Abyss still churn in the depths below the Underdark, representing an ongoing existential threat to the party’s escape.
source_quote: though the demonic forces of the Abyss still churned in the depths below them

subject: Zuggtmoy and Juiblex
fact: Zuggtmoy waits to claim what Juiblex had lost, indicating a cosmic rivalry or consequence tied to the fate of the ooze entities and the party’s escape.
source_quote: though Zuggtmoy waited to claim what Juiblex had lost

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir is a combatant who grapples the Pudding King, uses Stone Skin to resist acid damage, employs Shadow Step for mobility, and delivers the final blows that dissolve the Pudding King.

subject: Pudding King
fact: The Pudding King transforms into a sentient, telepathic ooze connected to Juiblex, unleashes slime waves and lair actions, and ultimately dissolves after taking thirty-seven points of damage from Zalthir, screaming telepathically about the soul's final blend.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool is a gelatinous cube that temporarily contains the Pudding King after a body swap, reacts with 'this tickles' when occupied, and reverts to its original form confused about the events.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin identifies the body swap between Glabbagool and the Pudding King by asking 'we met in a cake,' attacks the correct target with Dawnbringer, and uses opportunity attacks to immobilize the Pudding King.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz casts multiple Magic Missiles at the Pudding King, deals twenty points of damage with a third-level version, is covered in green slime, and uses Fireball to damage Prince Livid and Princess Ebonmire.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum casts Guiding Bolt and Inflict Wounds, deals twenty-three points of damage to the Pudding King, is knocked prone by slime waves, avoids green slime damage, and finishes Princess Ebonmire with Inflict Wounds.

subject: Prince Livid
fact: Prince Livid attacks Zalthir with a psychic blast, deals fourteen points of damage (reduced to seven), resists fire damage from Fireball, and uses a psychic attack on Daz for five points of damage.

subject: Princess Ebonmire
fact: Princess Ebonmire throws a blob at Thorin (misses), takes full damage from Fireball, charges Thorin, and is grappled and damaged by Zalthir before being defeated.

subject: Pudding King (ooze form)
fact: The Pudding King exists as a telepathic, acidic ooze capable of slime waves, lair actions, and body-swapping; it is vulnerable to radiant damage and cannot be permanently contained in a Bag of Holding.

subject: Green Slime
fact: Green slime is a hazardous environmental hazard in the lair that can attach to creatures; Grygum avoids damage from it with a successful Dexterity saving throw.

subject: Bag of Holding
fact: The Bag of Holding is considered for containing the Pudding King, but the DM rules that an ooze can 'ooze out' of it, allowing temporary action denial but not permanent containment.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a radiant weapon wielded by Thorin that deals twelve points of damage to the Pudding King when correctly targeted after the body swap.

subject: Stone Skin
fact: Stone Skin is a defensive spell used by Zalthir and Daz to reduce acid damage from slime waves and environmental hazards.

subject: Underdark Ooze Entities
fact: The Pudding King and Glabbagool are connected to the broader ooze ecology of the Underdark, with the Pudding King seeking to reduce all of it to ooze in service to Juiblex.

subject: Body Swap Revelation
fact: The party discovers that Glabbagool and the Pudding King have swapped identities, confirmed when the ooze responds 'we met in a cake' and Thorin correctly targets the Pudding King in Glabbagool's form.

subject: Pudding King's Dissolution
fact: The Pudding King dissolves after Zalthir deals thirty-seven points of damage, telepathically screaming 'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!' as he ceases to exist.

subject: Slime Wave Attack
fact: The Pudding King unleashes a slime wave affecting Zalthir, Thorin, Daz, and Grygum; Zalthir reduces damage with Stone Skin, while Daz and Grygum are knocked prone.

subject: Lair Action — Green Slime Drop
fact: The Pudding King uses a lair action to drop green slime on Grygum, but Grygum succeeds on a Dexterity saving throw and avoids damage.

subject: Drag Out of Lair
fact: Zalthir drags the Pudding King out of his lair using Steps of the Wind, neutralizing its lair actions and forcing it into Glabbagool's space, triggering a reaction.

subject: Fireball on Minions
fact: Daz casts Fireball dealing twenty-nine points of damage to Prince Livid and Princess Ebonmire; Livid resists and takes half, while Ebonmire takes full damage.

subject: Juiblex's Influence
fact: The Pudding King's transformation and telepathic goals suggest deeper influence from Juiblex, the Demon Prince of Oozes, though no direct manifestation occurs.

subject: Glabbagool's Confusion
fact: Glabbagool, now reverted to its original form, expresses confusion about the body swap, leaving open whether the event was magical, divine, or a permanent anomaly.

subject: session end
fact: The encounter concludes with the defeat of the Pudding King and his minions, marking the end of the session after coordinated assaults, revelations, and final blows.

subject: Pudding King
fact: A former humanoid who transformed into a sentient, telepathic ooze after embracing his connection to Juiblex, the demon lord of oozes. He commanded an army of oozes and possessed powerful abilities including slime waves and green slime attacks. He was grappled and dragged out of his lair by Zalthir, and at one point swapped positions with Glabbagool. He was ultimately defeated and dissolved, screaming 'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!' as he died.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: An intelligent gelatinous cube who was previously affected by demonic power. During the battle, he somehow swapped positions with the Pudding King, causing confusion for the party. After the Pudding King's defeat, Glabbagool returned to his original form and expressed excitement about potentially being carried in a jar or Bag of Holding, viewing his new mobility as an opportunity to experience the world differently. He sees himself as a potential garbage disposal and is interested in monk training.

subject: Prince Livid
fact: An ooze ally of the Pudding King who attacked with psychic blasts. He was resistant to fire damage, which allowed him to survive Daz's initial Fireball with only eight hit points remaining. He was ultimately killed by Daz's Magic Missile.

subject: Princess Ebonmire
fact: An ooze ally of the Pudding King who attacked by throwing blobs and charging at the party. She was killed by the party's combined efforts, and after her death, a spellbook containing many spells was found in her stomach.

subject: Juiblex
fact: The demon lord of oozes, whose power was channeled through the Pudding King. After the Pudding King's defeat, his infernal influence receded from the area, but a demonic voice claimed he would be reborn by consuming the Queen of Fungi.

subject: Zuggtmoy
fact: The Lady of Rot and Demon Lord of Fungi. After Juiblex's defeat, the fungi in the area became more twisted, suggesting she was waiting to seize power in the vacuum left by the Pudding King's death.

subject: Throne Room
fact: The Pudding King's throne room, accessed through a hole created by an Earth Elemental. The room contains green slime hazards on the ceiling that can drop on those beneath them. It served as the Pudding King's lair, granting him special lair actions until he was dragged out of it.

subject: Bag of Holding
fact: A magical bag capable of storing vast amounts of items and potentially creatures. The party discussed using it to contain the Pudding King, but the DM ruled that while it could temporarily deprive an ooze of an action, a sentient ooze could 'ooze out' of it and escape. Glabbagool later expressed interest in being carried in it.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: A magical weapon wielded by Thorin that emits light in a twenty-foot radius and deals radiant damage. It was used to attack the Pudding King after the party realized he had swapped positions with Glabbagool.

subject: Spellbook
fact: A spellbook containing many spells, found in Princess Ebonmire's stomach after her death. It significantly expanded the party's magical repertoire.

subject: Magic Missile
fact: A reliable force damage spell cast by Daz multiple times during the battle. It does not require a roll to hit and has a range of 120 feet. Daz used it at both first and third level, with the third-level version dealing twenty points of damage to the Pudding King. The final Magic Missile killed Prince Livid.

subject: Guiding Bolt
fact: A spell cast by Grygum early in the battle that missed its target.

subject: Stone Skin
fact: A temporary magical effect that grants resistance to a chosen damage type for one round, usable once per long rest. Multiple party members used it to resist acid damage from the Pudding King's slime wave attacks.

subject: Inflict Wounds
fact: A necrotic damage spell cast by Grygum that requires the target to make a constitution saving throw. It was used successfully against the Pudding King for twenty-three points of damage and against Princess Ebonmire for eighteen points of damage.

subject: Fireball
fact: A powerful area-of-effect spell cast by Daz that deals fire damage in a large area. It dealt twenty-nine points of damage to both Prince Livid and Princess Ebonmire, though Prince Livid's fire resistance reduced his damage to fourteen points.

subject: Shadow Step
fact: A monk ability used by Zalthir to teleport short distances, allowing him to quickly close the gap to enemies. He used it to reach the Pudding King and Princess Ebonmire during combat.

subject: Second Wind
fact: An ability used by Thorin to heal himself during the battle.

subject: Eldritch Claw
fact: An ability used by Zalthir that adds force damage to his melee attacks, manifesting as damage from his tentacles. Each hit adds 1d6 force damage.

subject: Revivify
fact: A resurrection spell mentioned by Zalthir as a potential option to help Glabbagool, though it was not cast as Glabbagool was not dead.

subject: party leveling up
fact: The party levels up after defeating the Pudding King and his allies.

subject: Juiblex's power receding
fact: The party feels the toxic flow of Juiblex's power receding from the area after the Pudding King's defeat.

subject: Zuggtmoy's influence growing
fact: The fungi in the area become more twisted, suggesting Zuggtmoy is waiting to seize power in the vacuum left by Juiblex's defeat.

subject: demonic declaration
fact: A demonic voice, possibly Juiblex himself, declares: 'You haven't won. I will be reborn. I will consume the banquet of the queen of the fungi, and I will grow.'

subject: Glabbagool's monk training
fact: The party discusses Glabbagool's potential monk training and his desire to be carried in a jar or the Bag of Holding to experience the world differently.

subject: Glabbagool as garbage disposal
fact: Glabbagool suggests he could be carried in a jar or the Bag of Holding and serve as a garbage disposal.

subject: spellbook acquisition
fact: The party finds a spellbook containing many spells in Princess Ebonmire's stomach, significantly expanding their magical repertoire.

subject: Pudding King's death cry
fact: The Pudding King screamed 'Behold the true feast, the soul's final blend!' as he dissolved upon defeat.
